settings.heading: Tire & wheel brands stocked in Calgary
settings.tldr: Prince Tires stocks 60+ tire brands, plus wheels, at our 111 42 Ave SW Calgary shop — from premium Michelin and Bridgestone down to value picks like Radar and Compasal. The brands below are the lines we stock deepest. Price match with local independent shops, same-day installation, 4.9★ from 750+ Google reviews.
settings.subtitle: The brands below are the lines we stock deepest — browse by brand and find the right fit for your vehicle. We carry 60+ tire brands in total, so if you don't see yours, we can source it.
settings.faq_1_q: What tire brands does Prince Tires carry in Calgary?
settings.faq_1_a: We stock 60+ tire brands, plus wheels, at our 111 42 Ave SW Calgary location. Top sellers include Michelin, Bridgestone, BFGoodrich, Toyo, Yokohama, Mickey Thompson, Continental, Cooper, Firestone, Kumho, and General Tire. Value lines include Radar, Compasal, Tesche, and Cargomax.
settings.faq_2_q: Do you carry budget tire brands?
settings.faq_2_a: Yes. Radar, Compasal, Tesche, and Cargomax cover the under-$150-per-tire range in common sizes. Every budget tire we install passes the same balance, torque, and TPMS reset as a premium tire — we don't cut corners based on what you paid.
settings.faq_3_q: Do you price-match local independent tire shops?
settings.faq_3_a: Yes. Show us a written quote on the same tire from a local independent Calgary tire shop and we will match it. The match applies to in-stock equivalents; out-of-stock or special orders are handled on a case-by-case basis.
settings.faq_4_q: Are all the tires you list actually in stock?
settings.faq_4_a: Most sizes in our top brands are in stock at 111 42 Ave SW. If a tire is on order, we will tell you up front and quote a realistic ETA — usually next business day from our Calgary supplier, or up to 5 days for special-order imports.
settings.faq_5_q: Can I get same-day installation in Calgary?
settings.faq_5_a: Yes for most stocked sizes if you book before midday. Bigger jobs (3/4-ton trucks, duallies, trailers) need a 60-minute slot — book online or call (403) 452-4283 to confirm we have a bay free.
settings.faq_6_q: Do you carry winter-rated 3PMSF tires for Calgary winters and BC mountain highways?
settings.faq_6_a: Yes. Every winter and all-weather tire we sell carries the 3PMSF (three-peak mountain snowflake) symbol, the winter rating to look for in Calgary. Alberta has no winter-tire law, but BC requires winter-rated tires on most highways, including Hwy 1 and Hwy 93 west of the Alberta border, Oct 1–Apr 30.
settings.faq_7_a: For dedicated winter tires, Michelin X-Ice Snow and Bridgestone Blizzak WS90 are our two most-installed in Calgary — both stay flexible below -20°C. For one-tire-all-year, Michelin CrossClimate2 carries the 3PMSF snowflake, so it is winter-rated for Calgary driving. BFGoodrich KO3 is the go-to for trucks and SUVs running gravel or oilfield roads through winter.
settings.faq_8_q: What is the lowest-priced 3PMSF-rated tire you stock?
settings.faq_9_q: Do you price-match the big-box chains?
settings.faq_9_a: No — we price match local independent Calgary tire shops only, not big-box chains or online stores. Bring a written quote from a local independent shop on the same tire and we will match it. Special orders are handled case by case.
settings.cta_description: Tell us your year, make, and tire size and we will source it. Same-day on most stocked sizes, two business days on special orders.
